title: Phase contract
description: The frozen contract a phase is evaluated against: one phase of one plan snapshot (design §1.1, §7.1).

finalChecks.description: Plan 06c: the phase's final check, frozen into the contract. Only a candidate that has passed review with no open blocker runs it, once.

workers.description: Plan 06g: #+TT_WORKERS frozen into the contract — how many lanes one round runs. Present only when the plan asks for more than one; absent is today's single-candidate loop.

roundsAllowed.description: Plan 06g: #+TT_ROUNDS frozen into the contract — how many rounds the phase may spend. Absent means the default of 3 (core/rounds.ts's roundBudget).

seats.description: Plan 06h: #+TT_REVIEWERS frozen into the contract. Absent means M A B.

leader.description: Plan 06h: #+TT_LEADER frozen into the contract. Absent means the first seat.
